def __init__(self, pattern_list, dirname, sep):
        if pattern_list and isinstance(pattern_list[0], str):
            pattern_list = [PatternInfo(pattern, "") for pattern in pattern_list]

        self.sep = sep
        self.pattern_list = pattern_list
        self.dirname = dirname

        self.regex_pattern_list = [
            GitWildMatchPattern.pattern_to_regex(pattern_info.patterns)
            for pattern_info in pattern_list
        ]
        
        # Make group names unique by adding an index to each pattern
        self.ignore_spec = []
        for ignore, group in groupby(self.regex_pattern_list, lambda x: x[1]):
            if ignore is not None:
                patterns = []
                for i, (pattern, _) in enumerate(group):
                    # Replace named group with indexed version to avoid conflicts
                    # The pattern from GitWildMatchPattern uses 'ps_d' as the group name
                    pattern = pattern.replace('(?P<ps_d>', f'(?P<ps_d_{i}>')
                    patterns.append(pattern)
                
                self.ignore_spec.append((ignore, re.compile("|".join(patterns))))
